## Which UAE small businesses does this suit?

The Web Makers works best with UAE small businesses that need a professional, enquiry-generating website without a large agency budget or a long production timeline. That includes:

🏪Retail & local shops 🩺Clinics & healthcare 🍽️Restaurants & cafés 🏢Real estate & property 💇Salons & beauty 🔧Home services & trades 💼Consultants & freelancers 🚀New RAKEZ / free-zone startups 🛍️Online shops & e-commerce 📚Training & education

If your business is based anywhere across Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, Ajman, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah or the wider UAE, The Web Makers serves you — everything runs over WhatsApp and email, so location within the UAE makes no difference to the service or the price.

Proof [...] Small business website design means building a fast, mobile-friendly, professionally structured website that fits a small business's real budget, launches quickly, and is optimised to bring in enquiries from UAE customers — not just a site that looks nice and sits there.

For most UAE small businesses, that means a WordPress website or a Shopify/WooCommerce online store with a WhatsApp contact button, clear pricing or service information, basic local SEO setup, and content that makes a first-time visitor feel they're in the right place. It doesn't mean paying agency prices or waiting months for a launch. [...] Yes — and The Web Makers includes on-page SEO setup in every build as standard. This covers proper heading structure, meta titles and descriptions, mobile optimisation, and connection to Google Search Console and Google Analytics, giving your small business a real foundation for local UAE search visibility.

WordPress is the best fit for most UAE small businesses — it's affordable, flexible, and lets you manage your own content after launch. WooCommerce is ideal for shops. Shopify suits businesses that want a fully hosted online store with minimal technical management.

An estimated 50% of SMEs across Dubai indicated that they have a website. This means the other half is not visible, cannot be found online. When it comes to SMEs using technology, we are aware of the challenges that they may face. Bearing that in mind, our mission is to help our customers turn their ideas and projects into real success stories. We provide them with the online tools and services to help them create and manage their business’s online identity and attract new customers. We focus on supporting SMEs on their online journey by providing inspirational and educational videos and articlesto assist and guide them in building their digital identities.
